title: Define and implement Hermes-native GateOutcome ingestion
objective: Implement a versioned GateOutcome 1.0 contract and deterministic Hermes-native adapter boundary that converts explicit gate-log outcomes into ProgressTrace events and signals. The adapter must use only structured deterministic gate-log data, preserve provenance for derived fields, and leave unsupported semantic fields authored and explicitly marked rather than guessed. Design this task jointly with phase-4-1-agent-session because emitted outcomes become the ordered invocation/session evidence. Preserve all existing Phase 0–3 contracts and Core semantics. Do not parse conversation text, call an LLM, or promise OpenTelemetry/generic adapter compatibility.
depends_on: phase-4-1-agent-session must be reviewed jointly with this task before implementation
required_contract_decisions: GateOutcome 1.0 records the gate command or stable command identifier, exit code, timestamp, targeted obligation identifier when available, closed verdict (pass, fail, skipped, error), and source digest.

The contract distinguishes observed gate-log fields from derived canonical trace fields and from authored fields; provenance is explicit and no field is promoted to observed truth merely because an adapter produced it.
A missing obligation target remains missing or explicitly unresolved; the adapter never guesses an obligation from command names or free-form text.
Timestamp and ordering normalization are deterministic and compatible with the reviewed AgentSession ordering boundary.
Gate-log to trace-event and signal mapping is a pure local transformation with no network, database, shell execution, model invocation, or hidden state.
The adapter fails closed on malformed, incoherent, duplicate, unsupported, or unverifiable source records and does not echo untrusted values in diagnostics.
The adapter can emit the existing canonical inputs needed by the unchanged .NET evaluator while preserving fields it cannot derive for explicit authoring.
The existing reference-adapter-v0 remains experimental/internal; this task does not create a universal adapter or compatibility promise.
deliverables: GateOutcome 1.0 JSON Schema and normative contract documentation
Deterministic validator, normalizer, and Hermes gate-log projection adapter
Explicit provenance representation for source, derived, and authored fields

Valid, invalid, and golden fixtures covering pass, fail, skipped, error, repeated gate outcomes, missing obligation target, malformed source, duplicate records, unsupported verdict, and source digest handling
Integration fixtures showing gate outcomes projected into existing trace/ledger inputs without changing Core semantics
Conformance, schema, determinism, redaction, and regression tests
README and CI usage updates limited to this contract
Self-check evidence listing exact commands, fixture counts, changed paths, frozen-path verification, and unresolved items
non_goals: No parsing of conversation content or semantic interpretation of free-form command output
No OpenTelemetry, framework-generic, or external-provider adapter
No persistence, hosted service, UI, or network calls
No automatic agent interruption or action on a gate verdict
No changes to existing Phase 0–3 schemas, semantics, or benchmark corpus
No synthetic benchmark expansion and no threshold tuning
No cryptographic attestation implementation from ADR-0006
stop_conditions: The shared AgentSession/GateOutcome boundary requires changing an existing integrated contract without an approved architecture revision
A source field can only be populated by conversation interpretation, model inference, or an invented default
The adapter requires network, database, shell, persistence, or hidden state
Existing Phase 0–3 fixtures, schemas, CLI behavior, reference-adapter regression, or deterministic semantics regress
Untrusted source values would be echoed in diagnostics or treated as instructions
The allowed path set is exceeded
Two bounded repair attempts are exhausted
